releases.name: r12.1.5.9
releases.notes:
- Added MoP Classic support for arenas and battlegrounds
- Removing global enable arenas/battlegrounds in favor of letting each group size control enabling
- Update roster building from the scoreboard to be more dynamic
- Added cast bar icon visibility and size controls
- Fixing bugs in arena
- Fixed target and focus clicks on flag and orb carriers during combat when objectives changing carriers
- Improved profile creation, reset, import, and export
- Added `/bgef` as a shortcut to the settings

releases.name: r12.1.5.8
releases.notes:
- Refactor the database setup to not use AceDB anymore
- Make the positions of the frames editable in the settings
- Move profile import and export into the profiles tab

releases.name: r12.1.5.7
releases.notes: - Fixing an issue with the database library not respecting settings
